content.value_statement: Solo founders often build too much before proving demand. This skill guides validation, MVP scope, pricing, and launch steps for focused SaaS products.
actual_capabilities: Guides early idea validation with interviews, landing pages, pre-sales, and competitor checks.
Scopes a two-week MVP around one core feature and a simple launch-ready stack.
Suggests pricing models, starting ranges, tiers, trials, and common pricing mistakes.
Identifies launch anti-patterns such as building in secret, feature creep, and underpricing.
Highlights sharp edges around distribution, market selection, churn, and pricing clarity.
limitations: Does not build or deploy the SaaS application by itself.
Does not replace legal, tax, accounting, or payment compliance advice.
Provides general startup guidance that still needs market-specific customer research.
Does not guarantee revenue, traffic, conversions, or product-market fit.

use_cases.title: Validate a SaaS Idea
use_cases.description: Assess buyer pain, willingness to pay, competition, and simple tests before investing build time.

use_cases.title: Plan a Two-Week MVP
use_cases.description: Convert a broad product concept into one core feature, a simple stack, and a launch-ready schedule.

use_cases.title: Improve Launch Readiness
use_cases.description: Review pricing, positioning, distribution risks, churn signals, and confusing purchase paths before launch.

prompt_templates.title: Validate My Idea
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me evaluate this micro-SaaS idea: [idea]. Identify the buyer, pain, willingness to pay, validation tests, and main risks.

prompt_templates.title: Scope My MVP
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn this product concept into a two-week MVP plan: [concept]. Keep one core feature and list what to skip.

prompt_templates.title: Set Pricing and Launch Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a pricing and launch plan for [product]. Include target customers, alternatives, starting price, trial strategy, and first channels.

prompt_templates.title: Audit My Micro-SaaS Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this micro-SaaS plan for weak assumptions, feature creep, pricing risk, distribution gaps, and churn risks: [plan].

output_examples.input: A founder wants to build a subscription dashboard for Shopify store owners.
output_examples.output: The skill would narrow the buyer, test the pain with interviews, compare alternatives, and recommend a landing page or pre-sale test.

output_examples.input: A developer has many SaaS features and wants a fast first version.
output_examples.output: The skill would choose one core workflow, define a two-week schedule, defer nonessential features, and prepare launch basics.

output_examples.input: An indie team is unsure whether to charge 9 or 49 dollars per month.
output_examples.output: The skill would compare customer value, manual alternatives, competitor pricing, trial options, and the risk of underpricing.

best_practices: Validate demand with real buyers before building the full product.
Ship one core feature first, then use feedback to decide what to add.
Set pricing from customer value and alternatives, not only development time.
anti_patterns: Do not build privately for months without customer conversations.
Do not add every requested feature before proving the main workflow.
Do not choose the lowest possible price to avoid rejection.

faq.question: Who is this skill for?
faq.answer: It is for solo founders, developer founders, and small teams planning a focused SaaS product.

faq.question: Can it help before I have a product?
faq.answer: Yes. It can help test the idea, define the buyer, and choose validation steps before development.

faq.question: Does it choose a technical stack?
faq.answer: It suggests simple solo-founder stack options, but final choices should match your team and constraints.

faq.question: Can it create a pricing model?
faq.answer: It can propose pricing tiers, trial ideas, and starting ranges based on value and alternatives.

faq.question: Does it replace customer research?
faq.answer: No. It helps plan research, but you still need conversations, tests, and real market evidence.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill metadata lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
